source.permission: The project owner states that ExamPrepper has approved collection for this application.
source.blocker: After the user signed into a dedicated regular Chrome browser, the SC-900 question and answer UI became accessible. The first two browser-generated discussion requests still returned HTTP 429 with a Vercel verification challenge. These are incomplete captures, not confirmed empty discussions. No access-control bypass was attempted.

practice.formatNotice: The certification page specifies 45 assessment minutes. Forty questions is this app's practice format, not a claim about the real exam's exact question count. AZ-104 retains its existing 40-question, 60-minute format.

publicationGates: Verified complete authorized source capture with all pages, answers, assets and discussion threads reconciled.
Every canonical question has topic, duplicate, relevance and answer review, with original teaching explanations and explicit uncertainty where necessary.
Unsupported or outdated questions are excluded from new practice rather than guessed or silently re-keyed.
All original SC-900 modules and 58 announced-outline objectives are independently reviewed and digest-approved.
Multi-exam account, attempt, learning, topic and offline storage is isolated, retaining all old AZ-104 data and links.
Only approved immutable data is uploaded with the existing Firebase identity, quota, privacy and budget controls.
Public Git contains source, original lessons and synthetic fixtures only, not the imported question bank.
